Hardsigmoid activation: relu6(x + 3) / 6.

A sigmoid made of straight pieces: 0 below -3, 1 above 3, (x + 3) / 6 between. Cheap to compute; MobileNetV3 uses it as the gate of its Squeeze-Excitation blocks. Same as torch.nn.Hardsigmoid.


## Tips

- The gate of MobileNetV3's Squeeze-Excitation blocks.
- A value between 0 and 1 where Sigmoid is too slow.
